recognize_zh: 這是頭部矢狀面顯影電腦斷層（CT venography），箭頭指向上矢狀竇（superior sagittal sinus）處顯影缺損，提示靜脈竇血栓；在急性前骨髓性白血病（APL）的情境下，要想到凝血異常或 ATRA 相關的血栓併發症。
features: Sagittal contrast-enhanced CT (CT venogram) of the head
Arrow indicates the superior sagittal sinus near the vertex
Apparent filling defect/reduced opacification of the sinus at the arrow, suggesting cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
Cortical veins and deep venous structures otherwise opacified
No morphologic (cellular) findings; radiologic image only
describe_en: Sagittal contrast-enhanced CT venogram of the head. The arrow points to the superior sagittal sinus, where there appears to be a filling defect with reduced contrast opacification, consistent with cerebral venous sinus thrombosis; resolution of the reproduced image limits detailed assessment. No intraparenchymal hemorrhage is evident on this single slice. In a patient with acute promyelocytic leukemia, this finding illustrates that thrombosis, not only hemorrhage, can complicate APL-associated coagulopathy and its treatment (e.g., ATRA).

ddx.vs: Hemorrhage appears as hyperdense parenchymal, subdural or subarachnoid blood on non-contrast CT, rather than a non-opacified venous sinus on venography.
Arachnoid granulations are small, round, well-defined defects often with CSF density, whereas thrombosis produces a longer segmental filling defect confirmed on MR venography.

ddx.dx: Dural sinus invasion by myeloid sarcoma or meningeal leukemia
ddx.vs: Tumor shows enhancing soft-tissue mass or dural thickening rather than a purely intraluminal non-enhancing clot.
